workflow: A conversion routine retrieves an element from an owning sequence through a non-owning reference and invokes user-controlled conversion logic.
The conversion logic mutates the sequence and releases its last ownership of the current element.
The conversion routine continues along an error or validation path and accesses the borrowed element as though it remained alive.
The access dereferences freed memory and terminates the process instead of reporting a recoverable conversion failure.
summary: Reentrant mutation invalidates a borrowed element during conversion
